request.style: English, female solo voice with warm character, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, piano, soft strings, nostalgic and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Pharaoh named him Zaphenath-paneah
Gave him Asenath, daughter of Potiphera
Priest of On, a wife of grace
Joseph stood before the king
Thirty years old in that land
He left the palace, traveled on

[Chorus]
May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh
Blessed with names that carry on
Inheritance equal, sons of Israel
Adopted in the covenant home

[Verse]
Before the famine came to pass
Two sons were born in the land
Manasseh, the firstborn son
God made him forget his hardship
Ephraim, the fruitful boy
Born where he had suffered long
Asenath, mother of these two
Secured their place in the genealogy

[Chorus]
May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh
Blessed with names that carry on
Inheritance equal, sons of Israel
Adopted in the covenant home

[Bridge]
Jacob sat up on his bed
Saw his face again at last
Took the boys to his heart
Crossed his hands in blessing
Right hand on the younger head
Left hand on the firstborn son
I know, my son, I know
The younger will be greater

[Chorus]
May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh
Blessed with names that carry on
Inheritance equal, sons of Israel
Adopted in the covenant home

[Outro]
So he put Ephraim ahead
Of Manasseh, the firstborn
